image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a forest floor covered in brown leaves and twigs. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and stripes. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible with small dark eyes, and the limbs are short and stout. The tail extends towards the right edge of the frame.
